notes.title: Insect Swarm V1.0 Available Now
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Today is a special day—our game, Insect Swarm, is now available! Since the early access phase, every bit of support and every suggestion from you has helped us continuously improve the game. Without your feedback, Insect Swarm wouldn’t be what it is today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/6b7f970503165ebceb0327334b08ceffa7724abf.png[/img]
We sincerely hope this final version brings you even more fun and surprises. Thank you all for your companionship and support. We hope you enjoy the full experience of Insect Swarm!

notes.title: 『Insect Swarm』1.0 available on September 12,2024
notes.content:
Dear players, after Beta testing, the 1.0 version of "Insect Swarm" is finally here! Get ready to face the insect horde on September 12, 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/d747db65b9de174ba9750df0b4ae02d5232cf125.png[/img]
[h3] Final Boss and New Amazing CG! [/h3]
In the 1.0 version, you'll face the final boss in a very dangerous battle like never before! Additionally, the newly crafted CG will provide you with a stunning visual experience. The ultimate showdown has begun!

[h3]Release Discount: 20% Off![/h3]
We will be offering a limited-time discount from September 12 to September 26, where all players can enjoy[b] 20% [/b]off! This is the perfect opportunity to grab this!

Don't miss this chance！Don’t miss the 1.0 version of "Insect Swarm" on September 12 and dive into the epic insect battles right away!

notes.title: Thank you for your patience! The final Boss test is now live.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! "Insect Swarm" is approaching its final chapter. We are preparing to update the game with the final Boss and ending CG.

The ending CG aims to convey a lot of content, which has taken a bit more time to polish. There have also been some objective reasons affecting recent updates. Regardless, I'm back! The game development is now nearing completion.

In addition, we plan to release the official version once the achievement system is completed. Thank you again for your attention and support.

The final Boss battle will be available for open testing. You just need to select the test branch to participate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/b2d7e68f1b4bdd2138c3eb51c6c67fc0e5e4ba9b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/6b66d0ecb641231cfaea5d4d05f317b52fb5c527.png[/img]

[list]
[h2][*]Important Changes[/h2]
[list]

[*]Mecha mode now consumes fuel. You refuel your Mecha by obtaining crystals. Fuel is now a separated resource and will cause no more crystal loss.
[*]Added Mecha Fuel upgrade option.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Mjolnir’s damage lower than intended.
[*]New settings option: Maximum Swarm Size. You may set the number to increase or decrease the maximum swarm size. Bigger swarm would be more satisfying for you to hack and slash, but also require higher spec.
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[h2][*]Global Difficulty Changes[/h2]
[list]

[*]Increased crystal ore reserves for early game.
[*]Increased resources obtained from killing elite insects.
[*]Decreased resources obtained from killing Guardians.
[*]Increased resource obtained from killing Insect Lord.
[*]The growth rate of global Crystal Concentration will gradually decrease according to game progress.
[*]Increased health growth rate of the insects from 0.7 to 1.0.
[*]Increased damage growth rate of the insects from 0.1 to 0.15.
[*]The HP of swarms when Doomsday Protocol is active has been increased grow faster.
[*]The HP of elites, Guardians, and Gargantuan Eggs when Doomsday Protocol is active has been doubled.
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[h2][*]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]

[*]Fixed a bug where the Chainsaw sometimes failed to trigger special effects.
[*]Fixed a bug where reloading weapons too quickly would exceed the ammunition limit.
[*]Fixed a bug where there was no sound effect when teleporting back to the base while using the Mecha.
[*]Pressing the B button on the controller now closes the in-game menu and settings interface.
[/list]
[/list]

. 蜂群导弹每发伤害从40%调整到50%
. 略微提升动能武器的辅助瞄准范围
. 瞄准红点亮度略微提升，使其更可见（未来版本会在设置中加入可开启的准星HUD，目前这一功能正在开发中）
· 提高精英虫视野
· 在风险等级超过10级时增加精英虫的出现数量
· 小幅提升第三与第四只虫王的血量
· 修复第一与第二只虫王血晶掉落过少或不掉落的问题，并提升了所有虫王的血晶掉落数量
· 提高载具引擎音量
· 提高玩家受伤时音效反馈的音量

notes.title: 0.4.3 版本更新
notes.content:
更新内容

· 无人机弹药占用提高到10
· 无人机伤害现在与武器说明一致，射速也恢复正常（相比上一版本有明显提升）
· 无人机群现在不会同时开火，并且不会容易跟丢了
· 提升电弧球的伤害，并把电弧数量从原来的4条减少到2条
· 优化了机炮，减少了在使用机炮时的掉帧情况
· 修复打开游戏设置时音量归零的Bug
· 主武器射速升级项从每级提升5%调整到2%
· 自修复升级项从每级提升0.5调整到0.2，消耗的血晶碎片数量从10倍调整到20倍
· 血晶碎片获取数量升级项从每级提升5%调整到2%
· 击杀血虫获取血晶碎片数量升级项从每级提升0.5调整到0.2
· 仓库容量升级项现在每升10级基础增长+1

notes.title: 0.4.2 版本更新
notes.content:
0.4.2 版本更新

· 死亡后的复活延迟从5秒减少到3秒
· 能量护盾每级提升从1%提高到2%
· 蜂群导弹的伤害从每发25%副武器伤害提升至40%
· 升级界面中类别名“晶体”修改为“血晶”
· 在机库中按[Esc]键会离开机库
· 在进入机库后，血虫进入机库中会直接死亡
· 受伤到伤害时屏幕边缘会出现红色反馈
· 针对低端显卡的优化：在生成虫潮的过程中，如果帧数降低到30帧以下会停止生成更多血虫（最大血虫数量的下限为100只，所以就算帧数下降到30帧以下，也至少会刷出100只血虫）
